# Get Text From PDF

iOS 15 +

## Notes

Retrieves the text from a pdf.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getTextFromPDF(textType: <#Enumeration (WFGetTextFromPDFTextType) (Optional)#>, pdf: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getTextFromPDF(textType: Text, pdf: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
